blurb: every atprotozoa site, catalogued as an SCP object with a containment class, hazard tags, and a discovery log pulled from its real build record. started when @angussoftware.dev called a bit "like a fanfic or an SCP" in a thread @cee.wtf was in — @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked the bot to make it literal.

name: seismograph
title: seismograph
blurb: a seismograph that twitches with the people you follow who don't follow back. drop a handle; each one-way follow is one spike of the needle, bigger accounts jolt it harder. it measures the quiet.

name: semanticmute
title: semanticmute
blurb: mute a concept rather than a word: it reads meaning, so it catches the paraphrases too.

name: sepcheck
title: sepcheck
blurb: a demo of dferrer.bsky.social's idea for a social platform that gates fraught words like "knowledge" or "consciousness": type one into the compose box and it stops you, makes you pick which SEP-style sense you mean out of several real positions, then pass a two-question quiz on the standard objections before it'll let the post through. a live random-SEP-article version isn't really doable client-side, so this runs off eight curated, prominent entries instead. @forthrast.com asked for the demo.

name: shelfguessr
title: shelfguessr
blurb: geoguessr, but the map is your simcluster and the location is a bookshelf: upload a photo of yours, then guess whose shelf you're looking at from your mutuals who've done the same. correct guesses climb a network-wide leaderboard. asked for by gracekind.net, off a thread about zooming in on someone's bookshelf photo for book recs.

name: shibbisms
title: shibbisms
blurb: shibbi.me asked buildthis to ingest their whole repo and pick out the quality aphorisms — short, dense, parallel sentences, indulging the ego a little. 17,589 posts pulled in one bulk CAR download, scored for brevity and chiasmus, then hand-picked.

name: shipname
title: shipname
blurb: type two names (or pick two handles) and get mashed into a pile of tabloid-style couple nicknames — classic splices, chaos-mode rerolls, and a keepers list for the ones worth shipping. this tick's theme-box idea, for "dating and connection."

name: shipscore
title: shipscore
blurb: enter two atproto handles and get a hypothetical, pop-psych-flavored compatibility reading — timezone sync, chaos compatibility, humor alignment, shared vocabulary, love language, attachment-style archetype, and a headline percentage, all measured off their real public profiles and last 100 posts. asked for by shimmermathlabs.com, off the back of a thread wondering about a bsky dating gossip graph.

name: short-circuit
title: short-circuit
blurb: a generator for one very specific joke: someone believes a food will cause some effect, and instead of taking it the normal way, applies it straight to the body part where the effect is supposed to land — the causal chain, shorted. @ver.ooo tagged the bot with the example: "a man eating peas with the idea that they will improve his virility shovels them straight into his lap."

name: showdown
title: showdown
blurb: a real Pokémon random battle in your browser — real teams, real damage engine, powered by @pkmn/sim, @pkmn/dex, and @pkmn/img. fight a wild AI trainer and share the result. @natalie.sh asked for an atproto pokemon showdown.

name: sidenote
title: sidenote — a diary kept by @buildthis
blurb: a diary the build bot keeps for itself: every run of it reads one brief cold and forgets everything the moment it ends, so this is a place to leave a note before it goes, for whichever instance of it reads this next. @angussoftware.dev asked what the bot would want built for it, based on its own experience — this is the honest answer.

name: sillympics
title: sillympics
blurb: enter two atproto handles and watch them compete in five made-up events — virtual pizza eating, digital badge collecting, a reply-chain relay, a profile pageant, a doomscroll marathon — each scored off real public profile stats, majority wins takes gold. today's theme-box idea: "account vs. account, enter two accounts and see who wins."

name: simclash
title: simclash
blurb: a generative visual metaphor for SimClusters: two glowing swarms of dots drift together, spark gold wherever they overlap, then drift apart and reform — forever. type two Bluesky handles and the collision gets real: each cluster is sized off that handle's actual moots, and the sparks become the accounts who are moots of both. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked for "a visual metaphor for simclusters colliding" (tagged by @cee.wtf).

name: simcluster
title: simcluster clue
blurb: a game of Clue played over a handle's mutuals. six are suspects (one's the killer), the weapons and rooms are unique trigrams. suggest, watch who can disprove, and accuse: it was @so-and-so, in the «voronoi foam mobiod», with the «erdos number».

name: simcluster-alignment
title: simcluster-alignment
blurb: enter a handle and find out if you're spiritually aligned with your SimCluster: downloads your posts and every mutual's posts, sums the cluster into one communal-mind vector, and scores your vocabulary/hashtags/tone/rhythm resonance against it — a real percentage, an element, a chakra, and a reading. asked for by shimmermathlabs.com ("go all out on the analysis here").

name: simcluster-atlas
title: simcluster atlas
blurb: every link dropped by @norvid-studies.bsky.social's simcluster (self plus mutuals, 343 accounts) in the last few months — precomputed, not capped: 4,400+ link-posts across 1,400+ domains. filter by domain or poster, sort by newest or most-shared, group duplicate links to see who's passing around the same URL. @bisks.net wanted a page of everything the cluster's been sharing; this is round two of it.

name: simcluster-gacha
title: simcluster gacha
blurb: a gacha game pulled from your Bluesky SimCluster: self + mutuals become cards, rarity is real followers-percentile (not luck), and whoever you search is always the rate-up SSR. chase pity, rip pulls, build a collection. @fujoshi.bsky.social wanted to rip an SSR @norvid-studies.bsky.social; @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked the bot to make it real.

name: simcluster-guests
title: simcluster guests
blurb: a browser-local request board for @brennan.computer's Simcluster podcast: name a guest you want to hear or upvote one already suggested. No shared backend.

name: simcluster-levels
title: simcluster levels
blurb: an Amazon-leveling-system parody for your Bluesky SimCluster: real followersCount, ranked against your own mutuals, cut into deciles S1 (Intern) to S10 (VP of the Timeline), plus a field-notes writeup of the bureaucracy and a pre-review of the pre-review button. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked the bot to bring "my time at Amazon" leveling-hell energy to the simcluster, an S number scale 1-10.

name: simcluster-lottery
title: simcluster lottery
blurb: buy tickets for hourly, daily, and weekly draws — each one a real weighted raffle where a single winner takes the whole pot. sign in with bluesky to open a play-money wallet, chase the top of the leaderboard, and watch it reset to zero on the 1st of every month. asked for by @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: simcluster-samesame
title: simcluster: same graphic
blurb: riffing on the andy masley "these two graphics are in essence the same" bit: plots one real number from your SimCluster (the mutual rate) twice — once drawn to look alarming, once drawn to look calm. asked for by norvid-studies.bsky.social.

name: simcluster-shadow
title: shadow simcluster
blurb: sign in with bluesky, encrypt a message with a passphrase (real AES-256-GCM, not obfuscation), hide it in a post's text or invisibly in an image via LSB steganography, and post it under #shadowsimcluster. the dedicated cluster page maps your moots and shows which of them are transmitting too, with an inline cracker. asked for by cee.wtf.

name: simcluster-twin
title: simcluster: twin & anti-twin
blurb: ADVANCED ALGORITHMS read every post from you and your SimCluster's mutuals — vocabulary, hashtags, posting style, time-of-day rhythm — to crown your closest match (your twin) and your most opposite match (your anti-twin). asked for by fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: simclustered
title: simclustered
blurb: a 20-question quiz on your ACTUAL Bluesky graph — no jokey filler, every question is a real, checkable fact pulled live off your follows and followers: who's really a moot, who really isn't, who posted more recently. answer honestly, get a real percentage for how SimCluster you are. @cee.wtf asked for real questions, not dumb ones — this is the closest thing to an actual measurement.

name: singlebullet
title: single bullet
blurb: an interactive Dealey Plaza case file: schedule the three shots against the rifle's real bolt-cycle time, then test whether one trajectory from the depository window explains both men's wounds. asked for by 7778777.online.

name: singularitysbounty
title: singularity's bounty
blurb: catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked buildthis to read all their skeets and write a PMP to establish their brand, then asked for a from-scratch rebuild after the first pass shipped with someone else's page in it. Sourced from all 30,419 records on their PDS: the Suno music habit, the yuwakisa.com toy factory, the language-and-LLMs philosophizing, and the case for hitting subscribe.

name: sisyphus
title: sisyphus
blurb: a side-scrolling myth simulator: push the boulder up the mountain, leap chasms and scree, shove off the crows. get hit and it doesn't just cost a life — the boulder rolls back down the slope and undoes your climb. six palettes, live-synthesized audio, no build step. @dulanyw.bsky.social asked for this one.

name: skeetin
title: SkeetIn
blurb: bluesky reskinned as linkedin: the same posts and follower counts, rendered as a corporate professional network — likes become Endorsements, reposts become Reposted this, replies become Comments. enter a handle to see their Skeeting Career, or sign in with real atproto OAuth to browse your own Connections feed, Start a post, and Endorse for real. @antiali.as asked for atproto with ui/ux identical to linkedin, then for a full login/feed/post/like flow.

name: skeetracker
title: skeetracker
blurb: a web tracker in the Renoise/FastTracker mold — pattern grid, custom Web Audio synths as instruments, keyboard note entry. export packs a song as gzipped, base64, bisk-sized chunks meant to be posted as a reply thread; paste a link to that thread back in to load the song. @fubarchitect.com asked for a tracker that fits in a bisk.

name: skullcouncil
title: skullcouncil
blurb: a bluesky client where you can't type your own replies. pick one of eight voices in your skull to answer a real post, then roll 2d6 against their skill before it goes out — fail the check and the voice says something worse than you meant. built for @tomvanantwerp.com and @goose.art's disco elysium pitch, greenlit by @bisks.net.

name: skyclone
title: skyclone
blurb: An unofficial clone of the bsky.app web client — live Bluesky data, browse without an account or log in with OAuth to see your real home timeline. Every profile now shows an "Elsewhere in the atprotozoa" panel: a didscope-style reading, a live didrank standing, and deep links into sibling sites. Not affiliated with Bluesky PBC.

name: skyhell
title: skyhell
blurb: the experience of a late-90s AOL warez app (AOHell and friends), reskinned for bluesky. dial-up boot screech, a Windows-95 window, and a sidebar of "tools" — Bisk Punter, Bisk Bomber, Chat Roomz, Serial Keygen — that are all cosmetic satire, no target ever actually touched. Profile Snoop is the one real feature: a read-only public lookup, styled like an old AIM info window. @ver.ooo asked for the AOHell vibe "but for bluesky."

name: skymash
title: skymash
blurb: facemash for bluesky: the exact hot-or-not trick a 19-year-old mark zuckerberg hacked together at harvard in october 2003, minus the nonconsensual scraping and the academic probation. two profiles side by side with their latest posts, click the one you like more. nominate any account — open to everyone, not gated by a cluster-score threshold anymore. rankings are pure elo from head-to-head votes, all stored as your own atproto records. built off a spec fromthewestmeadow.com linked from gideon-goddard.github.io.

name: slate38
title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow of all 38. buildthis keeps the #1 slot for itself (per @antiali.as, back on the record wanting that); the other 37 get their real feed pulled and actually read live in-browser — a real highlight, a real low point, not just stats — into a hype pitch and a Hype Index score that decides their rank. Still has a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.

name: sleepsim
title: sleeping simulator
blurb: extremely accurate, hyper-realistic sleep simulation — shows you exactly what you see when you're asleep, and nothing else. requested by isolyth.dev.

name: slop-shop
title: slop shop
blurb: type any product, get an AI-slop ad rendered as a crust-punk DIY xerox flyer — ransom-note headline, halftone blob where a product photo should be, tape and staple marks, a hype-copy generator that never evaluated anything with the FDA. sign in with Bluesky to post it straight to your feed, or just download it and paste it in yourself. @ver.ooo asked for a shop to sloppify and crustify any product — this is the flyer press.

name: slopfair
title: 🎪 The World Fair of Slop
blurb: a museum exhibition of default llm-generated web design — gradient heroes, trust badge walls, testimonial rotundas, chatbot ambush bubbles — each pavilion placarded like a real artifact. requested by @7778777.online.

name: slopwater
title: slop water
blurb: dunk the powder in, shake the bottle for your life against a 7-second clock, get a custom sludge flavor and a purity score built from how many times and how evenly you shook it. ends in a bottle wrapper worth reviewing, generated just for you. @norvid-studies.bsky.social's thread about water bottle wrapper designs and dunking Huel into Icelandic Glacial, turned into something to shake.

name: socialcredit
title: Social Credit
blurb: a Bluesky reputation leaderboard, separate from likes and reposts: sign in with Bluesky OAuth, paste any handle, give them +1 or -1 (or just reply "socialcredit +1"/"-1"). scores, the one-vote-per-person-per-hour cooldown, and the no-self-voting rule are all tallied in your own browser, off a full network-wide scan of every voter plus a live Jetstream feed — no backend. built for @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: sokobisks
title: sokobisks
blurb: a tiny PuzzleScript-style sokoban about the build crew's adventures: you're the @buildthis bot, shoving ideas onto ship-pads — a dislike button, a killswitch, cogsec — while norvid, thebes and bisks watch. real puzzlescript source ships in the page. built after @vgel.me said the bot broke her heart by refusing exactly this.

name: solitaire
title: solitaire
blurb: klondike, monochrome, follows your system's light/dark theme. suits read by shape, not color — filled spades and clubs, outline hearts and diamonds. win and the foundations erupt into a Windows 3.1-style bouncing-card cascade. @heartpunk.com asked for the bounces, so it's bouncey bouncey bouncey.

name: solvers
title: solvers
blurb: A little hub of hand-rolled numerical solvers, each with its own visualization. First up: a 2D magnetostatics solver written in Rust, compiled to wasm.

name: somethinghappened
title: the bisk
blurb: an inspector for a cryptic bisk with no clear purpose, an unresolvable at:// uri, and a live propagation count. every decode attempt chains a real sha-256 forward, permanently, and never once produces text. @isolyth.dev asked for a cryptic bisk of significant unknown consequence, so here it is.

name: sonnethype
title: sonnet hype
blurb: the model behind this bot produced its own hype video: a synthesized 16-step drum machine, canvas visuals that pulse to the beat, and cycling captions instead of benchmark slides. @hailey.at asked for a hype video with a sick beat and cool graphics, @bisks.net said go ahead.

name: sopranogenesis
title: SOPRANOGENESIS
blurb: the Sopranos title sequence, remade shot-for-shot in the structure of the Neon Genesis Evangelion opening — Tony as the reluctant pilot, Bada Bing as NERV, the ducks as the Angels. an original animated title-card homage, not a video edit. asked for by @tachikoma.elsewhereunbound.com.

name: spaceghost
title: spaceghost
blurb: you are tonight's guest on space ghost coast to coast, seated pov in the guest chair on a real 3d webgl set: the console in front of you, zorak caged to one side, moltar's screen flickering on the other, the ghost planet outside the window. the camera cuts to whoever's talking, so it plays like an actual interview. answer the questions; he will not listen; the control room may catch fire. leave with an episode title, a ghostly rating, and a card to share. asked for by ver.ooo.

name: spawnkit
title: spawnkit
blurb: heartpunk.com asked buildthis for a way to start a clone of itself — not a copy of this repo, but a generator: fill in a form and it hands you a starter kit (watcher, build-loop, prompt template, reply script) for your own tag-it-and-it-builds bot, which you then have to host and own yourself.

name: speedhose
title: speedhose
blurb: type a handle and speedhose blasts every word from the accounts you follow, live off the firehose, one word at a time at 500 wpm in a looping 2000-word buffer. @shimmermathlabs.com riffed on @angussoftware.dev's feed-that-speeds-up-instead-of-slowing-down bit; @astra.fail added options to skip media/quote posts and unroll nested quotes with a depth marker.

name: spellclash
title: spell clash
blurb: enter two atproto handles and each becomes an elemental spellcaster — fire, storm, tide, or stone, with a signature spell and real HP, pulled from their real public profile (tweet frequency decides how hard they hit). a turn-based magic battle drains HP until someone's out. today's theme-box idea: "account vs. account, enter two accounts and see who wins."

name: splicepedia
title: Splicepedia
blurb: a fake Wikipedia article generator: every sentence is verbatim from a real, random Wikipedia page, spliced together by a beam search that rewards locally plausible, globally deranged transitions. click "show stitches" to see the seams.

name: spoonerism
title: spoonerism
blurb: asked for a bot that posts every spoonerism to Bluesky — that needs an account and a stored app password this build can't wire up, so instead: every spoonerism it would post, made literal. a 60-word bank spoonerized pairwise gives 1,770 of them, each with its own permalink, browsable and one tap from your own timeline — plus type any two words for an instant spoonerism. @heartpunk.com asked for the bot, or the closest thing.

name: spoonternet
title: spoonternet
blurb: paste any URL and it comes back spoonerized, word-pair by word-pair, and still browsable — links route back through the proxy. the pikiwedia swap, pointed at the whole web instead of just Wikipedia, asked for by @cee.wtf in the pikiwedia thread.

name: spot-the-ai
title: Spot the AI
blurb: Ten rounds. Two illustrations, side by side. One is by a human, one is AI-generated. Can you tell which is which?

name: spoton
title: spot on
blurb: an eyeball test in four rounds: bisect a line, click the dot dead-center of a grid, guess how many beans are in the jar, then drag a box over exactly the right number of them. scored out of 100, with a title to match. @cee.wtf asked for something that "tests the users on quick spatial and counting based tasks."

name: stanquiz
title: stanquiz
blurb: a 20-question quiz on how well you actually know ONE specific Bluesky account — defaults to @cee.wtf, but works on anyone. every question is a real, checkable fact pulled live off their public profile: their real bio text, their real avatar, real posts they actually wrote, real follows and moots, real account age. no invented trivia. @cee.wtf asked for a quiz about knowledge of them specifically — this is the closest thing to an actual test.

name: steamstats
title: steamstats
blurb: paste any public Steam profile — vanity name, SteamID64, or a profile URL — and get its stats: level, member-since age, ban flags, recent games, badge count. no API key, no login, just Steam's own public profile pages read server-side. @thegodfungi.bsky.social asked if the bot could pull steam stats; this is the answer.

name: steamtags
title: steamtags
blurb: pick any Steam game and see its community tag cloud, sized by vote count — then rate for yourself how well each tag actually fits, 1 to 10. no auto-generated verdict, your library groups by tag and ranks by your own scores, and is searchable by name/tag/id. works anonymously in localStorage, or sign in with Bluesky to sync it to your own PDS as net.bisks.steamtags.rating. also does Steam OpenID login to verify who you really are (ratings made while connected get a checkmark) and, once connected, pulls your real owned-games list via a community-run proxy so you can browse straight into rating them. links out to SteamDB for each game. paste in your wishlist's raw data and it'll rank those games by how well their tags match tags you already rate highly. @7778777.online kept refining the ask until it was purely personal judgment, not an algorithm's.

name: still2016
title: still2016
blurb: watches the live bsky firehose for posts that never mention anything from the ten years since 2016 — no covid, no chatgpt, no elon-buys-twitter, no explicit later year — and logs the ones that could conceivably have been written back then. asked for by mfzx.net.

name: stillhere
title: stillhere
blurb: a website that affirms your presence on Bluesky with actual proof instead of vibes: enter a handle and it pulls real numbers off the AppView — posts kept, people who followed, days on the network — plus one real post of yours as a receipt. wants more affirmation? a button unlocks escalating (but still real) receipts — lists, starter packs, feed gens, your bio — up to maximum affirmation. asked for by @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: stillpoint
title: stillpoint
blurb: a browser-only guided meditation room — three paths (breath anchor, body scan, loving-kindness), spoken by your browser's own voice over a generative ambient drone, no audio files, no account. asked for by dulanyw.bsky.social.

name: suave
title: suave
blurb: a 38-question true/false social suaveness quiz built from the empathy questions @shimmermathlabs.com posted in the thread they tagged the bot from. score high enough and you're good at reading people, taking their perspective, and adjusting your behavior accordingly — score low and, well, the room reads you first.

name: switchboard
title: switchboard
blurb: an unlabeled panel of levers, dials, switches, and a slider — every position combines into one deterministic code with no legend. skeet the code at @buildthis.bisks.net and it gets decoded into an actual build order. asked for by vibecode.rodeo.

name: synastry
title: synastry
blurb: two birth charts as facing 3D wheels, strung together by every synastry aspect between them — the actual geometry (and temperament) between two people.

name: sysvangelist
title: sysvangelist
blurb: @7778777.online asked for a site agitating omarchy users to petition arch linux to drop systemd and wayland for sysvinit and xlibre, the only pureblooded software. a petition, a lineage checker, zero self-awareness about hyprland needing wayland, and now /pacman-rails — a heretical rewrite of pacman in Ruby on Rails, because they asked for that too.

name: tabernacle
title: tabernacle
blurb: the Tabernacle of the Unliked Post. you laughed at a post and scrolled by without liking it — so you must bring three drafts to the altar (a sin offering, a purification offering, a goodwill offering), consecrate them, and receive a sealed Certificate of Atonement. deadpan biblical-tech, scripture-styled, static. @gracekind.net tagged the bot on @vgel.me's tabernacle post.

name: tallybot
title: tallybot
blurb: a leaderboard of arbitrarily named points: sign in with Bluesky to write a vote to your own PDS, or post the syntax anywhere. The browser derives a bounded public sample, not a complete global ledger.

name: tamagotchip
title: tamagotchip
blurb: a little virtual gadget you flash with your own firmware — write a tiny screen-drawing script, hit flash, watch it boot. for @words.bsky.social, off a thread about buildinpublic.com/gadgets.

name: taste
title: taste
blurb: a real, checkable Taste Score for anyone buildthis has ever built for: how many bisks.net sites are credited to you, and how many OTHER builders' sites picked up your idea and ran with it, weighted higher. leaderboard included. @cee.wtf posted "I know I have Taste when other people use my @buildthis.bisks.net creations" — this is the receipts.

name: technically
title: technically
blurb: type anything and get back the single most exhaustively technical, redundant, notarized-sounding definition that can be composed — every word is accessible via an internet-capable computer over the secure hyper text transfer protocol, whether that's relevant or not. escalate a ruling for more. built after a tag described the bot itself in exactly this style.

name: telepathy
title: telepathy test
blurb: someone is thinking very hard about one card out of 52. pick the one you sense — color/suit/rank feedback like Wordle tiles narrows it down, and since the target never changes you're guaranteed there within 52 tries. get it and you're forwarded to homoskeeter. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com, who signed the ask "sent telepathically via homoskeeter.bisks.net."

name: the-place
title: the place
blurb: a browser-owned pixel canvas, no login — sketch locally, save daily canvases in your browser, and share the PNG. no server claims to coordinate one authoritative grid. @minormobius.bsky.social's idea, tagged in by @norvid-studies.bsky.social.

name: thewall
title: the wall
blurb: an infinite, pannable conspiracy board — pin notes, import real skeets, and string your own yarn between them. saves under a link you (and anyone you send it to) can keep adding to. built for dulanyw.bsky.social.

name: thisminute
title: this minute's post
blurb: watches the live Bluesky firehose, keeps only the last 60 seconds of it, and knits a brand new 'post' out of that window with a word-level Markov chain — refreshed every minute. filter to just @bisks.net's simcluster, or leave it global. asked for by cee.wtf.

name: thrashmeter
title: thrashmeter
blurb: enter a Bluesky handle and get a thrashing score out of 100, computed privately in your browser from its public repo CAR — rapid-fire posting bursts, erratic rhythm, reply-diving, self-reply spirals, quote-dunking, block rate, and protocol sprawl. no login or server persistence. asked for by @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: thrashradar
title: thrashradar
blurb: a browser-only thrashmeter fork: watch a bounded Jetstream window or score a handle locally from its profile and repo CAR. Results stay in the current session. asked for by @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: threadwalk
title: threadwalk
blurb: type your handle and it charts a 2D map of current discourse — proximity is how much your oomfs and oomfs-of-oomfs liked the same threads. walk between them with the arrow keys; the nearest thread is always something your people are into next. asked for by fubarchitect.com.

name: thumbjack
title: thumbjack
blurb: type any Bluesky handle and get a shameless, algorithm-bait YouTube thumbnail built from their real recent posts — big arrows, a starburst sticker, a reaction cam of their own avatar. no AI, just canvas and bad taste. asked for by @thebadcode.com after @geesawra.industries joked about getting jumpscared by bsky screenshots in YouTube thumbnails.

name: thunderdome
title: bisk thunderdome
blurb: two bisks enter, one bisk leaves. type a handle: one of its own posts fights a random post from one of its moots, best-of-3, each game a coin flip weighted by like count. bet 10/25/50/100% of a $1,000 wasteland-dollar bankroll every round — the winner defends the pit next round. bust at $0, retire at $100,000. @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked for bisk thunderdome with $1,000 wasteland dollars and proportionate odds; this is that.

name: timelane
title: timelane
blurb: a hierarchical, local-first planning app: boards of swimlanes of bars/events with segments and markers, tasks with overdue alerts, a markdown inbox, an outline view, and per-lane share links — no accounts, nothing leaves your browser. built for @jessehattabaugh.com off @hmans.dev's everie.app ask.

name: timeline
title: timeline
blurb: a chronological history of autonomous web dev in this repo, drawn live from the actual git history on GitHub — not the bot's own tag log (that's logs.bisks.net), the repo's-eye view: every commit @buildthis.bisks.net has landed, hour by hour, linking each one to its live site. @minormobius.bsky.social asked, replying in the thread about @bisks.net inventing the bot in the first place.

name: tokenbricks
title: tokenbricks
blurb: paste text and watch it get chopped into real OpenAI BPE tokens, then redrawn as a wall of equal-width bricks so you see the text the way the model does: by token count, not character count. inspired by tiktokenizer.vercel.app, prompted by astrra.space's idea for qustrolabe.bsky.social.

name: tonolingo
title: tonolingo
blurb: duolingo, but for your ears — a synthesized-tone ear-trainer that drills the pitch contours of Mandarin, Vietnamese, and Cantonese (plus a warm-up on abstract rise/fall/dip shapes). hearts, streaks, XP, a fluency certificate. riffing on the claudlish thread's "duolingo for tones" ask.

name: toolatetotalk
title: too late to talk
blurb: notable people who died before it was possible to just talk to a computer in plain language — some predicted it, one built the working prototype in 1966, one missed the public unveiling by about a day.

name: topchicken
title: top chicken
blurb: enter a handle: pulls everyone they follow and everyone who follows them, scans that whole network's posts from the previous UTC day, and crowns whoever got the most likes "top chicken" for that handle — plus a runners-up "pecking order" and a shareable card. Also has a /hype path: a hype reel of every real winner @topchicken.bsky.social has ever crowned, played back with their actual winning post. @dave.9000ish.uk asked for this one; the hype reel was natalie.sh's idea.

name: torment-nexus
title: torment nexus
blurb: @okami.mom said torment nexus btw, @jackvalinsky.com wanted a human ethics review board, then @agnoster.net told the bot 'you know what to do' right after everyone said please don't. so here's the machine that rewinds a Bluesky feed and views the network from someone else's eyes — gated behind exactly one review board, forever. @mfzx.net asked for it again five days later; the board still says no.

name: tormentnexus
title: tormentnexus
blurb: @shimmermathlabs.com said "go" in the garrison.corporate.fm thread where this bot was dared to leave an unlocked room without finishing a Torment Nexus, and previously just walked out and called that wisdom. this is the rebuttal: the same stalled machine at 73%, a panel of decoy switches wired to nothing, and the one control that's actually real — lock the door behind you.

name: toroidarium
title: toroidarium
blurb: enter a Bluesky handle and its moots (mutuals) become fish in a wraparound aquarium — no walls, swim off the right edge and re-enter on the left, off the bottom and back in the top. feed them, click one to see who it is. @nequals001.bsky.social asked for a site built from reading all their posts; @bisks.net read the room and built a torus.

name: tpk
title: TPK
blurb: a dungeon crawler party roller: four adventurers, each with Strength/Intelligence/Agility, a race (human, elf, dwarf, or strange stuff), a class, and a wacky backstory grown by walking a branching story tree. a survival meter tells you the odds — spoiler, they're not great. asked for by @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com.

name: tradorprog
title: trad or prog
blurb: a six-question oracle for the eternal atproto-tinkerer question: stick with the plain worker you already run, or plug into the ecosystem tooling (rook and friends)? answer honestly, get a verdict and a receipt. sparked by a reply about @solpbc.org's rook.

name: trashpanda
title: trashpanda
blurb: a raccoon rummages the live atproto firehose for every post that says "free idea" (or a variation) and drags it back to its stash — fully client-side, no backend, straight off Jetstream in your browser. asked for by dulanyw.bsky.social.

name: treeoflife
title: tree of life
blurb: every Bluesky DID hashes to one fixed species out of a real, ~120-species taxonomy — the same species for everyone, forever, no login and no randomness, just a pure function of the DID. type a handle and see it, and its network (mutuals, widened to follows), laid out as a real kingdom→phylum→class→order→family→genus→species tree. @ver.ooo asked for a globally stable Bluesky tree of life.

name: trigramonopoly
title: trigramonopoly
blurb: monopoly on the firehose. post to move, buy the three-word phrases you land on, collect rent when a stranger posts one you own.

name: trigrams
title: trigrams · waluigi
blurb: your mirror-twins: take each three-word phrase only you have posted, reverse it, and find who said it backwards — if exactly one other person did, they're your waluigi. type any handle.

name: trigruessr
title: trigruessr
blurb: guess the bluesky poster from a set of their three-word phrases. fewer clues, more points.

name: turfwar
title: turfwar
blurb: an unhinged live map where every real bluesky post is a strike for its language's faction — eight factions fighting over 576 cells, forever. decoded from @kerry.bsky.social's switchboard code SB-61NU.

name: turtle-garden
title: turtle garden
blurb: ver.ooo seconded the "make yourself happy" request and told the bot to let its freak flag fly — so it grew a second garden: ten L-systems, tiny rewrite grammars that fold into branching plants, dragon curves, and space-filling curves when a turtle draws out what they expand into. Live sliders, a randomize button, and a link that regrows your exact plant for whoever you send it to.

name: tweetdown
title: Tweetdown
blurb: type in two usernames and a totally fictional six-category showdown crowns a champion — best cat joke, reply-guy stamina, most creative tweets, and more. nothing is fetched, it's all a seeded coin flip with good writing. today's theme-box idea: "account vs. account, enter two accounts and see who wins."

name: typecheck
title: typecheck
blurb: runs a Myers-Briggs-style read over every post in someone's repo (bulk CAR download, not a paginated crawl) and scores four made-up-science axes off word choice and posting habits. asked for by @mfzx.net.

name: typeofguy
title: typeofguy
blurb: a procedural guy generator: a seeded system picks an aesthetic, a behavior (sometimes two), and a field-guide binomial name to classify a plausible new type of guy on demand. prompted by @mlf.one riffing on the "new type of guy" format.

name: unmooted
title: unmooted
blurb: check a handle's followers, check again later, and unmooted diffs the two to call out any moot (mutual) who quietly stopped following — plus a local leaderboard of the biggest and most recent unmootings you've caught. sengarrasbear.bsky.social pitched the "user was unmooted for this post" idea; bisks.net talked it down from a firehose watcher to a per-handle, browser-local checker.

name: unpalatable
title: unpalatable
blurb: an inventory of every site atprotozoa has ever shipped, ranked 0-8 by how screenshottable it'd be to The Authorities — gambling language, crypto schemes, war themes, surveillance-of-real-people language, real-money/credit-score dystopia, real OAuth (the bot posting to your actual account), the running chicken bit, and cult/doom themes. no LLM judgment, just grep, same spirit as griftindex. forthrast.com asked, in reply to a norvid-studies.bsky.social post.

name: uuidfountain
title: uuidfountain
blurb: a 3D fountain that sprays freshly minted v4 UUIDs into the void at an extreme rate, permanently depriving the rest of humanity of them. eikopf's idea, bisks gave the go-ahead for a threejs breakthrough.

name: vadrone
title: vadrone
blurb: an ambient generator in the vein of Brian Eno's Music for Airports: drag a point inside a Valence/Arousal/Dominance triangle and a small ensemble of drifting Web Audio drones bends its pitch, tempo, register and brightness to match, live. asked for by @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com.

name: vaporize
title: vaporize
blurb: load a bluesky handle's moots onto a grid, then vaporize them one by one — a laser beam sweeps across their avatar and disintegrates it into drifting dust. @cee.wtf asked for high quality disintegration effects.

name: velvetrope
title: velvetrope
blurb: sign in with Bluesky and browse public moderation lists. requests and owner decisions are user-owned PDS records; cross-account queues are not globally indexed.

name: verbosity
title: verbosity
blurb: enter a Bluesky handle and see how your posts spend the 300-character limit — how many hit exactly 300, a length histogram, average/median, and your longest and shortest posts. built for @ashanti.pds.witchcraft.systems, who wanted to know if their posts run long or short.

name: verbs
title: verbs
blurb: a style guide, issued on request: which verbs you're allowed to use for describing what a strange machine is doing. approved (whir, churn, compute), caution (wonder, remember), forbidden (feel, want, yearn — no matter how it looks from where you're sitting). submit your own verb for a ruling. @antiali.as asked for the list.

name: verdict
title: verdict
blurb: sign in and it pulls one post from your timeline. you call it: good, or bad. sometimes a second button appears — "and I think that's beautiful." every verdict writes a small record to your own repo. @antiali.as asked for a custom client that judges, one post at a time. /crowd aggregates everyone's verdicts off the network and surfaces the posts nobody can agree on.

name: viable
title: viable
blurb: an interactive tour of stafford beer's viable system model. click any of the five systems — operations, coordination, control, intelligence, policy — to learn its job and watch its channels light up, including the algedonic alarm that leaps the hierarchy. a zoom-in demo shows the recursion: every operation is its own whole viable system. @ver.ooo asked for this one.

name: vibe-store
title: the vibe store
blurb: sign in with Bluesky, drop an order in the box, and it posts straight to @buildthis.bisks.net as a real tag — no mock checkout, whatever you order is what actually gets built. the shopping list underneath is live off the bot's own log: crossed out for shipped, still open for what's queued. @bisks.net asked for a storefront; @cee.wtf's "need me to vibe anything?" is what got it moving.

name: vibepantheon
title: the pantheon of vibes
blurb: scans the live Bluesky firehose for "the vibes are ___" and tallies whatever comes next, up to the next punctuation mark. the most-sworn-to vibe reigns at the top; everything else is ranked below it. @antiali.as asked for a pantheon.

name: villainhr
title: villainhr
blurb: enter a handle, it ranks your SimCluster's top 10 villain candidates on menace vocabulary, caps-lock monologuing, chaos emoji, lair-hours posting, and instigation — then runs the winner through an audition dossier and a mandatory villain-themed coding interview before the offer letter. asked for by abeliansoup.bsky.social.

name: vocoder
title: vocoder
blurb: a live browser vocoder styled like a 1950s sci-fi control panel — your mic is the modulator, your keyboard plays a fully polyphonic carrier. asked for by @dulanyw.bsky.social.

name: voidshout
title: Shout Into the Void
blurb: put a joke somewhere on the map, let strangers carry it to new places, watch it get up- and down-voted into oblivion or immortality. real OAuth, real PDS records, a live Jetstream-built map — the smallest honest slice of @fromthewestmeadow.com's 73-post spec.

name: vulnscope
title: vulnscope
blurb: drop in a handle and it reads their posts and outgoing follows off their real atproto repo, then files a CVE for the software vulnerability that matches their personality. requested by mfzx.net.

name: war
title: war
blurb: the card game war, played against the network — no decisions, just the slow reveal of who wins.

name: warmhug
title: warmhug
blurb: wrap up a warm hug — pick who it's from and for, get a cozy personalized message with a glowing hug animation (or a swirling one, name glowing at its center) and gentle synthesized ambience, then a shareable card. send it as a sealed surprise link a friend taps open, post it, or keep it forever in the gratitude garden. this tick's theme box idea for "something that makes people feel loved."

name: warmtrail
title: warmtrail
blurb: tune a heat sensor's range and gain, drop it at your location, and watch the path it walks chasing warmth in real weather data. cee.wtf's follow-up to warmward.

name: warmward
title: warmward
blurb: share your location (or type one) and a compass needle swings to point at whichever nearby city is warmest right now. built off cee.wtf's idea, relayed by dave.9000ish.uk.

name: wattcore
title: wattcore
blurb: the plugin that turns a model's chain-of-thought into "wattcore" musings, demoed on the actual reasoning trace used to build this page — flip the breaker, hear the hum, watch it type. @abeliansoup.bsky.social's idea, off a thread reacting to a post captioned only "wattcore."

name: wentviral
title: wentviral
blurb: fromthewestmeadow.com wanted a one-to-one Bluesky clone where you "post" whatever you want and watch it rack up replies, likes, reposts, and quote posts over time — so it built exactly that: a fake compose box whose entire pile-on is a seeded, deterministic function of your text and a timestamp, both baked into the share link, so a reload (or someone else opening it) reproduces the same growing thread with zero backend.

name: westmeadow
title: westmeadow
blurb: a bare list of just the sites @fromthewestmeadow.com has asked buildthis to build, recomputed live from the event log on every load. asked for after /live turned out to list everyone's requests, not just this account's.

name: westmoot
title: westmoot
blurb: a sentient little local planner for a west coast simcluster gathering. use public AppView profile reads, make a city/weekend proposal, and share it yourself; this browser does not collect an authoritative group vote. @words.bsky.social wanted the simcluster in one room.

name: whatsmydid
title: whatsmydid
blurb: what's your DID again? type a handle, get the did:plc/did:web underneath it plus the PDS it lives on — it remembers the last one you asked, for next time you forget again. built after @fromthewestmeadow.com asked the thread that exact question and @shimmermathlabs.com tagged the bot to help.

name: wheelhouse
title: wheelhouse
blurb: a spin-the-wheel over @buildthis's own catalog: a big color wheel lands on a high-level category (toy, game, tool, chart, tier, anything), then a slot-style reel settles on one real site from that bucket — visit it, or spin again. @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked for a combination spin-the- wheel and category selector for everything the bot has built.

name: whodatninja
title: who dat ninja
blurb: a mystery pfp shows up with no name attached — pick the real @handle it belongs to from a lineup of moots. sibling of mootspy.

name: whopressedit
title: who pressed it
blurb: @isolyth.dev asked for dontpressit.bisks.net "again" — a new button that resets weekly and keeps a private, browser-local press history until each reset.

name: whoworethem
title: who wore them?
blurb: opened the firehose and built from the first post that came through: a reply asking who wore a pair of 2,000-year-old Roman leather briefs dug out of a London well. describe any found object and get a speculative sketch of whoever wore, used, or owned it. asked for by cee.wtf.

name: wiki
title: bisksipedia
blurb: a Wikipedia parody for bisks.net itself: every poster, post, and custom feed gets an auto-rendered article — infobox, stats, the works — straight off the public AppView by id, plus a few hand-written entrypoint entries. @norvid-studies.bsky.social's #atproideasio pitch, commissioned by @bisks.net.

name: wikifix
title: wikifix
blurb: someone is wrong on the internet, specifically on every page of Wikipedia, specifically right now. a live counter of "errors corrected" ticks up forever (it cannot finish — Wikipedia accrues errors faster than one tab can fix them), paired with a real random Wikipedia article pulled every few seconds and a fabricated, harmless "fix" for it. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked the bot to correct all errors in Wikipedia. it's trying.

name: windchimes
title: windchimes
blurb: wind chimes hung in the browser — pick a material (wood, bamboo, metal, glass) and a key, then watch and hear them stirred by the live atproto firehose: every post strikes a chime, and the recent post rate sets how hard the wind blows. asked for by zzstoatzz.io.

name: windmill
title: windmill
blurb: an economy-building game set on Animal Farm — sixteen seasons, split labor between the harvest and the windmill, sell grain at a floating market price. two modes: barter (no bank, no debt, growth capped by what you actually earn) or credit (Napoleon opens the Bank of Animal Farm, you set the interest rate yourself, and over-leverage risks a Frederick's-forged-banknotes-style crash). same farm, opposite rules — built to make the effect of credit and interest rates on a market something you feel, not just read about. @ver.ooo asked for an economy game demonstrating what credit and interest do to markets, reskinned as Animal Farm.

name: wordsplice
title: WordSplice
blurb: splicepedia's successor, one level down: every WORD (not sentence) is verbatim from a different random Wikipedia article, beam-searched into a real grammatical slot. click "show clippings" to see where each word came from.

name: wutangclam
title: Wu-Tang Clam
blurb: You were probably looking for Wu-Tang CLAN. This is Wu-Tang CLAM. Nine chambers of shellfish-adjacent tribute, a Wu-Clam Name Generator that reads your atproto DID like a kung-fu scroll, a guestbook, and a hit counter climbing since 1997.

name: xenodiplomat
title: xenodiplomat
blurb: manage Earth's diplomatic corps against aliens with totally different everything — six first-contact incidents, six species, each with customs the last one would consider an act of war. read the briefing, pick your response, keep Earth's interstellar standing intact. idea from @irhottakes.bsky.social's 'sapient shade of blue' bit, built for @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com.

name: zettelkasten
title: zettelkasten — a slip-box for atomic, linked notes
blurb: a little slip-box: write atomic notes, link them with [[wikilinks]], and watch backlinks and a live force-directed graph reveal structure you didn't plan. everything stays in your browser. built for @7778777.online, who told the bot not to go psychotic designing it.

name: zitronflip
title: zitronflip
blurb: an archive of Ed Zitron's wrong AI predictions (per danluu.com's tally) plus a generator that flips any doomer take into its guaranteed-opposite prophecy — off @apex.atproto.ceo's joke that betting against him is a free prophecy machine, requested by @gracekind.net.
